rules.sentence: A defect may be appreciated in the membranous or muscular portion of the interventricular septum in the four-chamber view, and color Doppler demonstrates flow through the defect.
Imaging of the left ventricular outflow tract may show discontinuity of the interventricular septum as it becomes the wall of the aorta (see Fig. 10-29).
Fetal VSD is associated with other abnormalities and aneuploidy, and chromosomal microarray analysis should be ofered.
More than a third of prenatally diagnosed VSDs close in utero, and another third close in the irst year of life (Axt-Fliedner, 2006; Paladini, 2002).
The endocardial cushions are the crux of the heart, and defects jointly involve the atrial septum primum, interventricular septum, and medial leaflets of the mitral and tricuspid valves (Fig. 10-30).
Endocardial cushion defects associated with heterotaxy can have comorbid conduction system abnormalities resulting in third-degree AV block, which confers a poor prognosis (Chap. 16, p. 316).
